We need to determine crimes based on facts. Let's parse.

Facts: In static county, on Aug 30 2014, Zhang (villager) due to land dispute went to construction site to block. He was stopped by Wang (defendant). Zhang called his son Li. Li saw Zhang lying on ground, slapped Wang. Then Wang instructed workers to beat Li, causing Li injury. Li's injury is light injury level 1 (serious). After Li injured, Wang to avoid legal responsibility, finds Ren (someone) and instructs Ren to make false testimony of intentional injury, promising monthly 10k. Also Wang instructs workers Wang Jia, Han to go to police station to make false testimony that Ren injured Li. This leads to Ren being detained for suspected ... (some crime). So Wang's actions: ordering others to commit intentional injury (the beating) -> that's "故意伤害" (intentional injury). Also ordering false testimony (伪证) -> crime of "伪证罪" (making false statements). Also possibly "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫"? No. Also "妨害公务"? He ordered workers to go to police station to make false statements, maybe "妨害公务" (obstructing public duty). But typical crime: "伪证罪" (false testimony) under Criminal Law article 307? Actually article 307: "伪证罪" for giving false testimony in judicial proceedings. Also "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" not relevant. Also "故意伤害" for ordering assault. Also "帮助信息提供"? Not.

Thus crimes: intentional injury (故意伤害) and false testimony (伪证罪). Possibly also "聚众扰乱社会秩序"? Not.

Thus answer: [罪名]故意伤害;伪证<eoa>
